shared_elements: horizontal registers stacked one above another
repeated figures aligned along a row
justification: Both surfaces organise their imagery into stacked horizontal registers separated by narrow decorated or plain dividing bands, with profile creatures/figures repeated along each row, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a free-standing, irregular, heavily weathered pillar with a few large, schematic, boldly rounded animals, while B is a flat, extensive wall face carrying dense, finely detailed, evenly spaced processions of clothed human figures with crisp ornamental rosette borders — utterly different in scale, execution and subject.
